A team shaped by cricket

PNW Rhinos brings the game and its community together across the Pacific Northwest.

A story still growing

PNW Rhinos is rooted in a shared love of cricket and community across the Pacific Northwest. The club's story is built through the people who come together around the game.

The people behind the team

A cricket club is more than the players on the field. It's a community that shares the game.

  • Players

    The people who bring skill, effort, and teamwork to the game.

  • Supporters

    The friends and fans who share the excitement of cricket.

  • Community

    Everyone connected by a love of cricket in the Pacific Northwest.

Cricket is better *together.*

Get in touch with PNW Rhinos to start a conversation about the team and the game.
